svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 42 mm off 16 x 10 mm bar; file the ends square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Groove across the 16 mm width on the underside, in the middle:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6.2 mm wide, 6.5 mm deep. Saw two cuts, chisel or file out

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: between them, and check depth with the probe sleeve and pad.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two magnet pockets on the underside, 13 mm each side of centre:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12.2 mm across, 3 mm deep, with a flat-bottomed drill or an

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end mill in the drill press.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bond a 12 x 3 mm high-temperature disc magnet in each pocket with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: high-temperature epoxy, flush with the underside; same pole down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the sleeve lies in the groove on its 0.5 mm thermal pad;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the magnets pull the clip onto the frame and press the sleeve

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: down on the pad. The lead leaves along the groove.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: on a steel plate the clip sits flat and the sleeve cannot slide.
